customManagers.description: Released harmon-devkit tag pinned by root and template skills-sync manifests
Devcontainer Dockerfile ARG pins — suffix-matched so the template's Dockerfile.jinja (inside a jinja-named directory) is managed too
Shared image per-architecture release attachment digests

Shared remote-bootstrap tool pins, `FOO_VERSION=x.y.z` shell-variable style in images/devcontainer/versions.env. Root-only: that file is the single source of truth the shared image Dockerfile and bootstrap-remote.sh BOTH read, so a pin invisible here freezes the devcontainer and every remote environment at once. Generated repositories have no images/devcontainer/, so there is no template twin to keep in the same group.

Per-architecture checksum pins in images/devcontainer/versions.env — same shape as the workflow/action checksum manager below: `*_sha256=<hex>` under a `# renovate: datasource=github-release-attachments … digestVersion=<tag>` annotation, one annotated line per architecture. Node's digests are deliberately NOT managed here: nodejs.org publishes SHASUMS256.txt rather than release attachments, so they are hand-verified behind the `# verified-for:` marker scripts/test-bootstrap-remote.sh enforces.

Workflow and composite-action tool pins (both layers), `version:`/`<tool>_version:` style. Composite actions are included because template/.github/actions/setup/action.yml.jinja pins setup-task and setup-tflint this way, and a `workflows/`-only pattern leaves them invisible here — the same silent rot the SHA manager below was added for.

Workflow/composite-action and script tool pins, `FOO_VERSION=x.y.z` shell-variable style. Template scripts carry jinja in the FILENAME (`…foo.sh[% endif %]`), so the .sh alternative tolerates that suffix — without it every pin under template/scripts/ is invisible here.

Per-architecture checksum pins, `*_sha256=<hex>` under a `# renovate: datasource=github-release-attachments ... digestVersion=<tag>` annotation, one annotated line per architecture. When the paired `*_VERSION` pin moves, Renovate bumps the tag and recomputes the hash of the same release asset in the same PR. digestVersion is the RAW release tag (v3.14.1, no extractVersion) because the datasource looks the release up by that exact tag. Both layers: the template twin is matched through its jinja filename.

GitHub Action SHA pins (`uses: owner/repo@sha # vX.Y.Z`) in the template's .jinja workflows AND composite actions — the native github-actions manager can't parse the .jinja extension, so these pins rotted silently until the omator retro caught them. `actions/` is covered too: template/.github/actions/setup/action.yml.jinja pins setup-node, setup-python, setup-uv, setup-terraform and setup-tflint by SHA. Conditional workflow filenames (`…yml[% endif %].jinja`) must stay matched or their pins rot the same way.

Taskfile tool pins (root Taskfile + included taskfiles/, both layers), `FOO_VERSION: x.y.z` var style — used by the uvx-pinned foreman CLI (FOREMAN_VERSION in taskfiles/foreman.yml). The taskfiles pattern tolerates a trailing jinja conditional in the directory name (template/[% if use_foreman %]taskfiles[% endif %]/) — without it the template twin's pins are invisible to Renovate and only the root copy gets bumped, which fails test:dogfood-parity

packageRules.description: Never auto-merge anything
Wait 3 days before proposing any update
Batch all GitHub Actions updates into one PR
Batch regex-managed workflow and composite-action updates into one PR — the composite action provisions the same CI toolchain the workflows do, so its pins belong in the same batch
Batch all Docker image updates into one PR
Keep Ubuntu pinned to 24.04 LTS for remote-bootstrap environment parity; digest updates only

Batch the canonical shared-image source, current dogfood/template devcontainers, and their coupled script pins into one PR — must come after the Docker images rule so base images land here instead. Root scripts/** and taskfiles/** are included because their regex-managed pins are dogfood-parity twins of template/** copies; splitting a dependency across groups makes each Renovate PR fail parity. OH_MY_PI_SHA256_AMD64/ARM64 in images/devcontainer/Dockerfile are the one pin pair this batch deliberately excludes from that automation: oh-my-pi ships unsigned release binaries, so a person must verify each release by hand, and only OH_MY_PI_VERSION here is Renovate-managed.
prBodyNotes: If this bump touches OH_MY_PI_VERSION in images/devcontainer/Dockerfile, its hashes are NOT auto-updated: read the release notes and provenance, download the omp-linux-x64 and omp-linux-arm64 binary assets (not the source archives), compute their sha256, update OH_MY_PI_SHA256_AMD64/ARM64, and move the `# verified-for:` marker to match before merging. `task check` (scripts/test-oh-my-pi-pin.sh) fails fast until you do.

packageRules.description: Template workflow AND composite-action pins belong with the GitHub Actions batch, not the Devcontainer batch — must come after the Devcontainer rule (which claims all of template/**) so this override wins. Composite actions are listed explicitly: template/.github/actions/setup/action.yml.jinja pins setup-node/-python/-uv/-terraform/-task/-tflint, and without this line they would all be filed as Devcontainer updates

Give the checksum-pinned CI lint tools (shellcheck, shfmt, actionlint, yq, gitleaks) their own PR instead of the batched GitHub Actions group: their pins carry companion values (per-architecture hashes; for a formatter, what counts as correctly formatted), so one red lint-tool bump must not hold every Actions update back. Must come after the GitHub Actions grouping rules so this override wins. In this repo it must also follow the Devcontainer rule (which claims template/**); the Dockerfile copies of these pins stay in the Devcontainer batch.
prBodyNotes: Checksums move with their versions: every `*_sha256` pin carries a `github-release-attachments` annotation, so this PR should already contain the new hashes. If `task check` (scripts/test-tool-pin-pairs.sh) reports a hash left behind, retry this PR from the Dependency Dashboard rather than hand-editing the hash.
A formatter bump (shfmt) can change what `task check` accepts: run `task fix` and push the reformat as a separate commit; do not amend Renovate's commit.

packageRules.description: Keep shared image/remote ShellCheck and setup action pins in one CI lint tools PR; their version parity is gated by test-setup-action-tool-versions.sh.
Surface harmon-devkit releases for deliberate pin-and-sync updates
prBodyNotes: Normally unnecessary: `.github/workflows/sync-harmon-devkit.yml` already opens a complete pin-and-sync PR on every stable harmon-devkit release. This rule stays as a passive stale-pin signal and manual fallback: dashboard-gating means it never opens a pin PR unattended, but approving it while the automation is healthy produces a SECOND PR for the same bump. Leave it unapproved unless the workflow is broken and you are deliberately falling back to the manual route.

If you do approve this update, run `task sync:skills` and push the refreshed `.claude/skills/` as a separate commit; do not amend Renovate's commit. A ref-only bump fails the skills drift check by design.

packageRules.description: Batch the web-astro test-fixture dependency bumps into one PR (the fixture validates the shipped ESLint config; its deps move together)
Batch the web-app test-fixture dependency bumps into one PR

Reason: TypeScript 7 requires typescript-eslint support for its native compiler; Upstream: https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/issues/10940; Remove when: typescript-eslint supports TypeScript 7 and the canary Node and Astro checks pass with TypeScript 7; Canary: https://github.com/evanharmon1/harmon-init
Require explicit approval for package-manager majors because pnpm/npm/yarn migrations can change lockfiles, install behavior, and CI bootstrapping
prBodyNotes: Before approving this update, follow the [package-manager major-upgrade checklist](docs/CHECKLIST.md#package-manager-major-upgrades). If this repository deliberately stays on an older major, add a local disabling package rule whose description records why.

packageRules.description: Batch markdownlint-cli2 as "Formatters" — the template's twin rule also groups prettier and Black there, but this repo renders use_node/use_python off, so only markdownlint-cli2 applies here. Its script-pinned dependency (scripts/markdownlint.sh, under scripts/**) would otherwise land in the broad Devcontainer batch above; this rule must come after it (and after the fixture-specific groups, which own markdownlint-cli2 within tests/fixtures/** if it's ever added there) to reclaim it. shfmt is already isolated in the CI lint tools group (#1352) and is deliberately not duplicated here.
prBodyNotes: Run `task fix` and commit the reformat as a separate commit from this dependency bump; do not amend Renovate's commit.

packageRules.description: Eject anthropics/claude-code-action from the batched GitHub Actions group and skip the 3-day release-age wait. It ships near-daily first-party releases, so grouping + minimumReleaseAge kept the whole Actions batch perpetually pending on the renovate/stability-days gate — each rebase pulled in a fresh release and reset the 3-day clock. It's a trusted first-party action and all updates are reviewed manually (automerge is off globally). Must come LAST so this override wins over every grouping rule (GitHub Actions, Devcontainer, template workflow pins).

Eject ponderousdev/foreman from the Devcontainer batch (which claims taskfiles/**): a Foreman bump changes what `task foreman:*` executes and is reviewed on its own, not inside an unrelated tooling batch. Must come after the grouping rules so this override wins.
Ignore sesh v2.30.0 — upstream release was published without binary assets
Ignore tokei >=13.0.0 — upstream releases after v13.0.0-alpha.0 publish no prebuilt binary assets

Reason: Node 25 drops the bundled Corepack that the shared devcontainer image installer and the packageManager convention rely on, and a runtime major moves the runtime under the whole repository at once, so it must never ride along inside the batched GitHub Actions PR. Matches both extractions of the runtime: the annotated regex pins (custom.regex, datasource node-version) and setup-node's node-version input (github-actions manager, uses-with, datasource github-releases). The datasource matcher keeps out node Docker images, which the github-actions manager also extracts as depName node from a job container or service, and package.json engines.node and @types/node are not matched either: none of them is the runtime; Upstream: https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/51981; Remove when: the runtime moves to the next major deliberately, the shared image provisions pnpm without bundled Corepack, and the canary builds and checks pass on that major; Canary: https://github.com/evanharmon1/harmon-init
Group non-major npm lockfile updates
Group non-major pep621 lockfile updates
Group non-major gomod lockfile updates
Group non-major terraform lockfile updates
Keep lockfile ecosystem majors separate
